episode_row: Díaz pick never locked/posted: postponed game's projected batter held the gap check open

commits.subject: fix: exclude non-Preview games from should_lock gap check
commits.body:
The should_lock function in the scheduler was considering projected
batters from ALL games (including postponed/started/finished) when
deciding whether the gap threshold was met. This caused today's pick
(Díaz) to never lock because a projected batter (Kwan) from the
postponed CHC@CLE game was within 3% of the confirmed pick.

Filter all_pick_data by game status — only include batters from
games still in Preview (P) status.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: improve scheduler: short-circuit, logging, pick audit trail
commits.body:
Four improvements from today's debugging session:

1. Short-circuit before cascade: check if existing pick is locked
   (game started or posted) BEFORE running the expensive SSH
   prediction cascade. Saves ~3 min on every restart.

2. Log pick selection and should_lock decisions: each check now
   prints "Pick: Name (TEAM) XX.X%, gap=X.X% → should_lock=T/F"
   so future debugging doesn't require code archaeology.

3. Pick audit trail: runs_completed in scheduler_state.json now
   records pick_name and pick_p for each check, so we can
   reconstruct what picks were at each time.

4. Remove duplicate API call: short-circuit uses its own
   get_game_statuses call which replaces both the select_pick
   and should_lock calls when the pick is already locked.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
